files.contents:
name: "CI Reviewer"
provider: "openrouter"
model: "deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash"
system_prompt: "Review the diff.\n  Indented line: with a colon # and \"quotes\"\n\ttabbed line  \n"
skills:
  - "error-handling"
strategy: "single-pass"
ci_fail_on: "critical"
version: 2

# DevDigest Review · ci-reviewer — generated by DevDigest; included from the root CI configuration.
devdigest-review-ci-reviewer:
  stage: test
  image:
    name: buildpack-deps:trixie-scm@sha256:57c2de9a151180bf9ba8eea8bbebf8c546ccaa629f4fec8ea9b18330226af31b
    entrypoint: [""]
  inherit:
    default: false
    variables: false
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event" && $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_PROJECT_ID == $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_PROJECT_ID
  interruptible: true
  variables:
    GIT_DEPTH: "0"
    DEVDIGEST_PLATFORM: gitlab_ci
    DEVDIGEST_AGENT: ci-reviewer
    DEVDIGEST_POST_AS: github_review
  script:
    - mkdir -p "/tmp/devdigest-$CI_JOB_ID"
    - base64 -d "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.devdigest/runner/devdigest-runner-linux-amd64.gz.b64" > "/tmp/devdigest-$CI_JOB_ID/devdigest-runner.gz"
    - gzip -dc "/tmp/devdigest-$CI_JOB_ID/devdigest-runner.gz" > "/tmp/devdigest-$CI_JOB_ID/devdigest-runner"
    - cd "/tmp/devdigest-$CI_JOB_ID" && sha256sum -c "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.devdigest/runner/devdigest-runner-linux-amd64.sha256"
    - chmod +x "/tmp/devdigest-$CI_JOB_ID/devdigest-runner"
    - cd "$CI_PROJECT_DIR" && "/tmp/devdigest-$CI_JOB_ID/devdigest-runner"
  artifacts:
    when: always
    name: devdigest-result-ci-reviewer
    paths:
      - devdigest-result.json
    expire_in: 30 days

# Added by DevDigest. Add your own jobs below or in other included files.
include:
  - local: .gitlab/devdigest/review-ci-reviewer.yml
